#!/bin/bash
# Reviewer rehearsal (round 2), part 1: reversed order, EXAMIN first, this ACT's states and apply/undo.
set -u
W=/tmp/gov-launch-independent-auditor-z9fcihu6/claude-1000/rv-reds2
export HOME=$W/home
D=/home/usain/Dynamic-Agentic-Engineering-OS/.gov-runtime/scratch/orchestrator/drafts
R=$D/accepted-reds-1/acts-r2/ACT-ACCEPTED-REDS-1
R1=$D/accepted-reds-1/acts/ACT-ACCEPTED-REDS-1.r1
E=$D/examin-sets/acts-r2/ACT-EXAMIN-SETS-1
M=governance/project/path-map.yaml
cd $W/clone
hs() { sha256sum $M | cut -c1-12; }
echo "== B reversed order on $(hs)"
for s in check apply undo verify; do bash $R/apply.sh $s; echo "  $s exit=$?"; done
echo "  map=$(hs) status=[$(git status --short)] tmp=[$(ls governance/project | grep act-tmp)]"
echo "== r1 bundle on live map"
for s in check apply; do bash $R1/apply.sh $s; echo "  r1 $s exit=$?"; done
echo "  map=$(hs)"
echo "== EXAMIN r2 apply"
bash $E/apply.sh check; echo "  exit=$?"
bash $E/apply.sh apply; echo "  exit=$?"
echo "  map=$(hs)"
git commit -q -m "stand-in: ACT-EXAMIN-SETS-1 applied (reviewer clone)" -m "Role: operator" -- $M; echo "  commit exit=$?"
echo "== r1 bundle on EXAMIN-after map"
bash $R1/apply.sh check; echo "  r1 check exit=$?"
echo "== this ACT"
bash $R/apply.sh check; echo "  check exit=$?"
bash $R/apply.sh verify; echo "  verify exit=$?"
bash $R/apply.sh undo; echo "  undo exit=$?"
bash $R/apply.sh apply; echo "  apply exit=$?"
cmp $M $R/after/repo/$M && echo "  map == frozen after"
stat -c '  mode %a' $M
echo "  status=[$(git status --short)] tmp=[$(ls governance/project | grep act-tmp)]"
bash $R/apply.sh apply; echo "  apply-again exit=$?"
bash $R/apply.sh verify; echo "  verify exit=$?"
git diff --numstat -- $M
echo "== manifest checks as written"
python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; [print(c["cmd"]) for c in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["checks"]]' $R/manifest.json > $W/checks.txt
while IFS= read -r c; do bash -c "$c"; echo "  check exit=$?"; done < $W/checks.txt
echo "== EXAMIN undo with this on top (should refuse)"
bash $E/apply.sh undo; echo "  exit=$?"; echo "  map=$(hs)"
echo "== undo this"
bash $R/apply.sh undo; echo "  undo exit=$?"
cmp $M $R/before/repo/$M && echo "  map == frozen before"
echo "  status=[$(git status --short)]"
echo "== check 2 on before map"
sed -n 2p $W/checks.txt > $W/c2.txt; bash -c "$(cat $W/c2.txt)"; echo "  check2 exit=$?"
